description: This file defines functions and types related to outbound message targeting and heartbeat delivery in a messaging system, including resolving channels, targets, and sender contexts.

methods.name: resolveOutboundTarget
methods.description: Resolves the outbound target channel and destination based on provided parameters, including plugin resolution and default fallbacks.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Determines the delivery target for heartbeat messages, considering session context, configuration, and channel resolution.

methods.name: buildNoHeartbeatDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Constructs an OutboundTarget indicating no delivery (e.g., due to configuration or errors).

methods.name: inferChatTypeFromTarget
methods.description: Infers the chat type (direct, channel, group) from the target string.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatDeliveryChatType
methods.description: Resolves the chat type for heartbeat delivery, prioritizing session info and falling back to target inference.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatSenderId
methods.description: Determines the sender ID for heartbeat messages based on allowFrom list and delivery context.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatSenderContext
methods.description: Builds the context for heartbeat message sending, including sender ID, provider, and allowed sources.
